name: Ashe
source:
Ashe is a cheerful and naïve young girl who is ignorant in the ways of the human world, and relies on Leni and Seizh to provide her with shelter and care while she remains stranded. She is kind-hearted, albeit prone to the occasional temperamental outburst, but unfortunately lacking in much sense, due to her very restrictive upbringing. Feeling guilty and a burden on her father for being born with weak magic, she has vowed to do everything she can to restore his kingdom to its former glory. Thus, she resigns herself to enduring the twins’ harassment in silence, despite her revulsion and fear, in hopes of convincing one of them to become king in her father’s stead.

[From [url=http://eroderekko.wordpress.com/]Ero+Dere[/url]]
